goal: Travel from Pewter City through Mt Moon to reach Cerulean City.

subgoals.goal_text: Visit the Pewter City Pokemon Center to ensure the party is fully healed before heading to Route 3.
Purchase Potions at the Pewter City Mart to sustain the party through Mt Moon.
Leave Pewter City and enter Route 3.
Travel east across Route 3 to reach the entrance of Mt Moon.
Navigate through the first floor of Mt Moon to find the stairs leading down.
Navigate through the basement 1st floor of Mt Moon to reach the next level down.
Navigate through the basement 2nd floor of Mt Moon to find the exit leading toward Cerulean City.
Move back up to the B1F level to find the path toward the exit.
Locate and enter the Pokemon Center inside Mt Moon to heal up.
Heal the party at the Mt Moon Pokemon Center.
Exit Mt Moon and enter Route 4.
Travel west across Route 4 to reach the entrance of Cerulean City.
